title: Kestrel Rx Savings Club Savings Guarantee — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
The Kestrel Rx Savings Club renewal fee of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs, once reduced by its points off and rounded, is finished by the club savings guarantee. The guarantee compares the savings the membership gave on discounted fills dated fewer than 12 whole months before today with the fee most recently charged on the membership:

- where those savings are **less than half of that fee**, the whole shortfall (that fee less those savings) is taken off the reduced renewal fee;
- where they are **at least half of that fee but less than the whole of it**, the reduced renewal fee is multiplied by **0.90** and rounded to the cent half up;
- where they **reach that fee**, the reduced renewal fee stands as it is.

The savings are the savings off the usual price recorded on the membership's discounted fills dated in that window, added together. The fee most recently charged is the latest fee charge on the membership's fee history.

## Worked cases (hypothetical: fee most recently charged $20.00, reduced renewal fee $17.00)

| Savings in the window | Comparison with the $20.00 fee | Finished renewal fee |
|---|---|---|
| $6.00 | less than half ($10.00) | 17.00 less the $14.00 shortfall: $3.00 |
| $10.00 | exactly half: at least half, less than the whole | 17.00 multiplied by 0.90: $15.30 |
| $19.99 | at least half, less than the whole | $15.30 |
| $20.00 | reaches the fee | $17.00 |
| $31.50 | reaches the fee | $17.00 |
